Thanks Ava — looping internal panel.

Team: Samira is PST-AM preferred. I'm proposing an "interleaved" full loop on Weds 7/26, 09:00-13:30 PT with a 20-minute break at 11:00. The idea is to interleave systems + product panels to keep energy and allow shorter focused debriefs after each pair. Outline (tentative):

09:00-09:50 — Systems design (Camila + Karthik)
09:55-10:25 — Behavioral / leadership (Marissa)
10:30-11:00 — Deep dive coding + takehome discussion (Camila)
11:00-11:20 — Lunch/quick break (candidate)
11:25-12:10 — Performance / infra tradeoffs (Karthik + Logan)
12:15-12:45 — Product sense (Marissa)
12:50-13:20 — Open questions + debrief buffer (float)

Two operational asks:
1) Please confirm panel ownership and who will own the debrief write-up after the loop (we should avoid split responsibility).
2) We need a hot-swap plan in case an evaluator drops — who can float in at short notice?

I'll draft a .ics and a short rubric we can attach for each interviewer. If this looks good I'll send invites and copy Ava so Samira can accept.

- Logan
Head of Eng Recruiting (interim)

Agree with the interleaved flow. Two small asks:
1) Swap the first behavioral slot to after the first systems block (so candidate warms into product discussion rather than starting with leadership). That helps loosen temperature for high-stakes design prompts.
2) For the debrief ownership, I'm happy to do Product & Behavioral but can you add a 10-minute async write-up window (12:50-13:00) before final synthesis so I can capture notes?

Minor: can we call out the scoring scale in the rubric (0-4) in the agenda header — some interviewers still use their own scales.

Other than that, good to send.

Couple operational items for the hot-swap plan:

- Zoom protocol: use the backup-host link (in ICS) and include the prefixed meeting code "REDWOOD-INT-7/26" so Ava and Samira can easily join the fallback room.
